ammonia.reason: Low ammonia from limited amino acid deamination in low-moisture pressed curd.

animal_barnyard.reason: Sheepy wool/stable notes from p-cresol and branched-chain 4-methyloctanoic acids in ewe milk fat.

bitter.reason: Moderate bitter hydrophobic peptides from rennet and plasmin proteolysis during 4-6 mo aging.

blue_moldy.reason: Absent methyl ketones from Penicillium roqueforti; mold-free pressed rind.

browning.reason: Moderate Maillard browning from residual protein and low lactose plus caramelized notes on heating.

buttery.reason: Buttery diacetyl/acetoin from citrate fermentation by lactic starters plus 38.2% fat.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Sweaty butyric/hexanoic acids from moderate lipolysis, total FFA ~8.2 g/kg.

creaminess.reason: Creamy mouthfeel limited by 30% moisture firm matrix despite high fat.

crumbliness.reason: Moderate crumbly fracture from low moisture and extensive proteolysis weakening curd.

firmness.reason: Very firm pressed curd at 30% moisture and 6 mo aging.

fruity.reason: Fruity ethyl butanoate/hexanoate esters from FFA esterification with ethanol.

goaty.reason: Low goaty caproic/caprylic sharpness; ewe milk less goaty than goat despite short-chain FFA.

malty_nutty.reason: Nutty-toasty Strecker aldehydes 2-/3-methylbutanal and 2-methylpropanal from leucine/valine.

melt.reason: Moderate-low flow when heated due to low moisture, low pH and aged protein network.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Trace 1-octen-3-ol from fatty acid oxidation; no bloomy rind.

oil_off.reason: Moderate free oil release on heating from 38.2% fat in hard matrix.

smoky.reason: No smoking step and no guaiacol formation.

sour_vinegar.reason: Mild acetic/propanoic acid from heterofermentative metabolism and lipolysis.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata stretching; rennet curd does not form aligned casein fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Low dimethyl sulfide/disulfide and methional from methionine catabolism.

sweet.reason: Low residual lactose/lactate with toffee/caramel lactones giving slight sweetness.

umami.reason: Brothy glutamate and savory peptides from 26% protein proteolysis.
